paper.title: Neural circuit mechanisms for steering control in walking Drosophila
paper.published_claim: mean rotational velocity is consistently related to the right-minus-left DNa02 firing-rate difference; the relationship is essentially linear across its dynamic range

code_authorities.role: Python import/preprocessing contract and dual-recording aliases
physiology quality-control context; contains a low-SNR rejection of a2_d_14 for a separate physiology analysis

cohort_review_note: The paper reports n=4 paired DNa02 flies and general secondary-analysis dictionaries list a2_d_08/a2_d_12/a2_d_13/a2_d_14. However, physiology_quant_analysis_figures.ipynb excludes a2_d_14 as low SNR for a separate physiology analysis. The exact Figure 3C inclusion set must therefore be verified from panel-level provenance/data before freezing the cohort.

published_figure3c_preprocessing.spike_detection: relative-prominence peak detection as described in the version-of-record Methods
published_figure3c_preprocessing.alignment_interpretation: publication reproduction alignment only; may reflect biological delay and/or spherical-treadmill inertia and must not be treated as a universal model delay
published_figure3c_preprocessing.relationship: essentially linear across the full observed dynamic range
published_figure3c_preprocessing.normalization_policy: absolute gain is preparation-dependent; Program A should derive a normalized relational target only after exact cohort and source bytes are frozen

allowed_interpretation: DNa02 bilateral activity has a reproducible lateralized relationship to rotational velocity in the published preparation
a normalized bilateral steering relation is a candidate navigation-independent calibration target
forbidden_interpretation: the 150 ms publication alignment is a universal biological or model delay
the absolute firing-rate-to-turn gain transfers unchanged to exact MaleCNS DNa02 body IDs
a2_d_14 is included in Figure 3C merely because four generic dual-recording aliases exist
unmapped Dataverse files may be substituted by local or guessed session files
navigation performance may choose the cohort, preprocessing, normalization, or target statistic
